// conan-code-tour.ts — installed by Conan Code. Do not edit by hand; Conan
// Code overwrites this file on every launch to match the running app.
//
// Polls Conan Code's private control socket (via `coinorctl tour-wait`) for
// `point_to_code` requests queued by the native Grok tool of the same name
// (see ADR 0019), and opens each one as a one-step guided tour using
// Fresh's own bundled `code-tour` plugin.
const editor = getEditor();
let polling = false;

registerHandler("conan_code_tour_poll", async function () {
  if (polling) {
    return;
  }
  polling = true;
  try {
    const client = editor.getEnv("CONAN_CODE_CONTROL_CLIENT");
    if (!client) {
      return;
    }
    const result = await editor.spawnProcess(client, ["tour-wait"]);
    const tourPath = result && result.stdout ? result.stdout.trim() : "";
    if (!tourPath) {
      return;
    }
    await editor.getPluginApi("code-tour").openTour(tourPath);
  } catch (e) {
    // A flaky poll must not stop the loop; the next tick tries again.
  } finally {
    polling = false;
  }
});

editor.setInterval(2000, "conan_code_tour_poll");
